w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Redactor. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Spool, Big Big, Extended Warranty) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: "The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "THE COMPANY WINS!!" The crowd goes WILD! Team merch is already selling!"
✨ Ability gained: Foresight (L1). Reveal every monster’s intended move for three rounds. Uses no combat action; once per fight.
"The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
"The REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Loud." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/12/9), with 5 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 25 → 24 · capped · Craft 7 · Talk 15 · Explore 34 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sam Wilson ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen from its recent high again — the shelves are thinning.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,281 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
